name: sl-web-components
description: The Southleft brand design system — opinionated section components built on Altitude

scripts.//build: NOT yet wired into the root `build:all` — the only consumer today is the Southleft Storybook, which compiles these sources directly through its own Vite. Wire it in when apps/southleft imports the package (spec 2026-08-22-southleft-brand-design-system-as-a-linked-layer-on-altitude, T11).
scripts.build: del-cli dist && vite build -c vite.config.mjs && tsc

//sideEffects: Source paths as well as dist, for the same reason as al-web-components — see the note there. Every component module here ends in a `customElements.define` guarded by `alAutoRegistry`; if the bundler thinks the module is side-effect-free it drops the whole import and the element silently never upgrades in a production Storybook build.
